criterion_bindings.exemption: Policy-only planning authority under CD-0121. Document and knowledge checks validate the authored contract; runtime Product-mode routing requires separate implementation and activation evidence.
Process-authority assignment for public merge evidence. Repository review and CI retain their existing verification contracts; a document check alone does not prove a particular merge.
Policy-only preservation of branch and worktree isolation. Existing worktree authority contracts and tests own runtime verification; this amendment does not alter that mechanism.

Policy-only requirement for explicit law amendment. Knowledge closure and law-relation checks validate declared records, while review must establish that the change addresses its substantive law conflicts.

Policy-only mode-appropriate planning linkage. Existing session identity verification remains in force; implementation must separately prove local work linkage and configured Linear linkage without a universal GitHub prerequisite.
This amendment preserves the existing durable workflow authority. Generated agent contracts and store workflow tests own its runtime evidence; no workflow implementation changes in this policy work.
This policy separates replacement-readiness claims from integration activation. The accepted floor manifest and scripts/check-floor-readiness.py retain their own evidence contract.
The predecessor-independence boundary is unchanged. scripts/check-predecessor-independence.py checks declared repository-owned surfaces; this policy does not introduce an external write route.

Normative Product-isolation and local-only scenario. No Linear runtime is introduced here; credential independence and cross-Product isolation need executable evidence in the integration implementation.
Normative remote-creation identity requirement. A confirmed Linear issue must be proved by the later integration route, not by these document or knowledge checks.
Normative outage and planning-authority requirement. Failure and queue semantics need separately scoped runtime tests; this amendment does not claim a synchronization mechanism exists.
Normative distinction between selected mode and verified activation. The supported setup route must supply activation evidence; policy adoption and structural document checks do not supply it.
Normative cutover and identity-preservation requirement. Any migration requires explicit approval and executable evidence under its own contract; this policy does not migrate existing records.
Policy-only outside-work boundary under CD-0122 D1. Host permissions remain authoritative, and outside work creates no Concord workflow evidence.
Policy-only defect-repair application under CD-0122 D2. Repository isolation and public review evidence remain required; no runtime repair route is added here.
Policy-only host-role preservation under CD-0122 D3. This amendment changes no host-owned permission, session, directory, or participation rule.

summary: Defines Product-scoped planning, explicit Concord workflow participation, authorized outside-work defect repair, truthful activation and cutover, and separate repository and host authority.
title: development authority
